content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, medical-necessity, or missing-information issue, so another peer-to-peer or necessity appeal would not address the denial basis. No coding error or separately payable modifier is documented to support correction and resubmission, and the contractual denial cannot be shifted to the patient; specialist review is therefore required to determine whether the bundling adjudication can be challenged."}
